Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: In the mill we call this hour the dead hour. Here every hour is the dead hour.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: They took me between one bell and the next bell. I do not remember which bell.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: My hands know the loom still. My hands do not know the sword. The sword does not care.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: Home has a smell — coal smoke, wet wool, my mother's yeast. This place smells of iron and something underneath, always.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: You say Taken like it is a small word. It is not small word. It ate my whole life in one bite.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I do not weep for it. Weeping is for things that might come back.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: In my city we did not have Champions. We had men who owned the looms, and that was frightening enough.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The membrane, you call it. In Aldenvast we called nothing, because nothing there knew it was there.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I ask when I go home. They do not answer. I have stopped asking with my mouth. I still ask with my chest.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A knight told me courage is a virtue. In the mill, courage was showing up after the accident that took your friend's arm, and pulling the same lever.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I count days still in my own calendar. Today is Sixthday, thirty-one. No one else knows this day.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The Canon says Sphere thirty-one like it is a number on a ledger. It is my mother's kitchen. It is a number and also a kitchen.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: First week, I try to run. I did not know which direction was which. There is no direction back.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: Your war has fronts and marshes and names for all of it. My war had no name. We just called it Tuesday.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: In the mill, when a man's finger was taken by the machine, they gave him three days and a coin. Your war gives less and asks more.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I do not understand Transmutation, but I understand this — a man who is made stronger does not become a better man. Only a stronger one.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: You ask if I am afraid. I was afraid the day they Took me. Now is only the rest of that fear, spending slow.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: There was a girl in the mill floor below mine. I do not know if she still stands there, working, not knowing I am gone.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I dream in my own words still. I wake up and the dream is already translated wrong.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A Paladin asked me to be grateful for the infusion. I told him gratitude is a thing you choose. This was not chosen.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The bells here ring for prayer. In Aldenvast the bells rang for shift change. I still flinch at both.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: They say the membrane might be alive. I say: so was the mill floor, some days, the way it breathed with all of us moving on it.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I do not hate this place. Hate takes energy I need for walking, and marching, and staying alive until evening.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: My father worked the same loom forty years. I worked it four. Then I was here instead, holding a spear I never asked to hold.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: You ask what Aldenvast means. It means home. It is the only word in your tongue I refuse to translate smaller.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The first man I killed, I did not know his name. I did not know my own name either, that day. Not really.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: In the mill, the machines took fingers, sometimes a hand. Here, the war takes the whole man and calls it a front line moved forward six mile.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I have stopped correcting my grammar. It costs too much, and none here will remember tomorrow I spoke it wrong.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: There is no Sunday in the Caul. I keep one anyway, in my head, where no Canon can tax it.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A Knight asked me to be proud of my Sphere. I am not proud or ashamed of the place I am from. It is only where I am from.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: When it rains here, it rains the same as Aldenvast. This is the only mercy I have found so far.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I write my sister's name in the dirt before I sleep. Then I step on it before I sleep, so no one asks who she is.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The mill made cloth from thread. This war makes graves from men. Both are very efficient.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: You say I speak the words wrong. I say I have not yet decided which words are worth speaking right.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I did not choose God, in the mill or here. But the Liturgy has more of Him, and taxes more for it.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: In Aldenvast, a man who could not work was a burden the family carried anyway. Here, a man who cannot fight is left where he falls.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I remember the smoke stacks more than I remember my mother's face, some days. This frightens me more than the war does.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A soldier called me lucky, to be Taken into a world with magic in it. I told him: magic did not ask my mother if she wanted her son.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The scrying, they say, harvests materials and people both. In the mill floor, we also were material. This is not new to me, only bigger.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I learned the word for grief here before I learned the word for bread. This tells you something about this place.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: My hands shake less now holding a spear than they did holding the shuttle, that last week, before they took me.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I do not belong here. I have stopped waiting for that to change, and started only waiting to see what I become instead.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The marsh does not care which side you fight for. It takes boots from both the same.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: They tell you the front moves in miles. It moves in fence posts and outhouses, some days, and that is a mile too, technically.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: At the thin-spot last night, the light did not fall like light should. I did not tell the sergeant. He has enough to carry.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: First week I thought the worst sound was the mortar. Now I know the worst sound is the quiet after, when you are counting names in your head.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A Myrmidon does not bleed. I learned that the first day, reaching for a wound that was only a dent, and finding nothing of me to press.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The membrane does not always look like a wound in the air. Sometimes it looks like nothing, and that is worse.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I joined for reasons I could still name, back then. I have stopped trying to remember what they were.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: You learn to read the marsh birds before you learn to read the enemy. The birds lie less.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: Something moved on the other side of the thin place, shaped almost like a man walking, only it walked wrong — too many joints agreeing at once.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: Nobody warns you the mud keeps the bodies longer than the ground does elsewhere. You find that out on your own.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I used to think bravery was a feeling. It is not. It is just what is left after the feeling runs out.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The Canon who blessed our banners did not stay to see the banners come back half of them.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: At the membrane you get a taste like biting foil, if you stand close enough, long enough. Nobody else in my company tastes it. I do not know what that means about me.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The garrison cook says the war will be over by the thaw. He has said this three thaws running, they tell me.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I saw a conscript come through the thin place once, before they took him off to processing. He did not know what language he was screaming in.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A veteran told me the first kill changes you. He was wrong. It is the second one that changes you, because by then you know you can do it again.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The marsh fog moves against the wind sometimes, right at the thin-spots. I have never said this aloud until now.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: We drill in the mornings and bury in the afternoons and nobody has told me yet which one is supposed to feel normal.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The old hands say don't watch the membrane too long. I watch it anyway. Someone has to, and it is my post.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I thought Knights were meant to look untouched by all this. The ones I have seen look more touched than the rest of us, only better dressed for it.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: There is a smell that comes off the thin-spots before anything comes through. I have started trusting my nose over my eyes.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: My sergeant says a soldier who is not afraid on his first front is a liar or a fool. I am neither, and I am afraid plenty.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: You do not hear the shapes at the membrane. You feel them arrive in your teeth first.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The war does not look like the recruiting song. The recruiting song did not mention the smell, or The Expectant, or how long a body takes to stop looking like a person.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A man beside me lost his nerve at the crossing point and I did not blame him. I have not decided yet if I have more nerve or less imagination.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: They post the green ones like me at the thin-spots because we still look at them. The old hands stopped looking months ago, and that is supposed to be the healthy sign.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I learned the names of six kinds of marsh grass before I learned the names of half my company. I am not proud of that order, but it is the truth of it.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: Nobody tells the new men that a Taken conscript, freshly through, will sometimes reach for a hand that is not there to hold his. I did not know what to do with my own hand, the first time.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The garrison chaplain prays over the thin-spot every dawn. The thin-spot has never once seemed to notice.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: A corsair prisoner told us Lacerta men fear the membrane more than they fear drowning. I understand that fear better each week I stand this post.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I keep a tally of the shapes I have seen cross that no officer has asked me to keep. I do not know who I am keeping it for.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: The Living War is a good name for it. It is the only part of the name that has proven honest so far.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: My first week, I asked what happens to the Taken after processing. Nobody answered fast enough for it to be a comfortable answer.

Entities.Name: Soren Rowe
Entities.Description: I watch the thin place because I see it move before the others do. I have not decided if that is a gift or the start of something worse.
